node.description:
__Rank:__ ~!As of now in the Manga, Iruma achieved Rank [5] *He*.!~
__Familiars:__ ~!His very first and only familiar is a demon named [Callego Naberius](https://anilist.co/character/135021/Callego--Naberius), whom he managed to summon in the form of a flying owl in episode 2 of the series.!~

A human boy whose parents sold him to a demon named [Sullivan](https://anilist.co/character/135023), who subsequently transports him to the Demon World and adopts him as his grandson. He starts his new life by being enrolled into Babyls Demon School, where he constantly has to hide the fact that he is a human in order to avoid being eaten. However, after quickly making friends with fellow classmates [Asmodeus](https://anilist.co/character/135022/Alice-Asmodeus) and [Clara](https://anilist.co/character/135019/Clara-Valac), he eventually grows accustomed to his new lifestyle through both his numerous adventures and encounters with other demons.

__Height:__ 190cm
__Rank:__ ~!As of now in the Manga, Ameri has achieved rank [6] *Vav*.!~ 
__Relatives:__ [Merize](https://anilist.co/character/326718) (Mother), [Azazel Henri](https://anilist.co/character/155682/Henri-Azazel) (Father)
__Familiars:__ ~!It is yet unknown.!~ 
__Inherited Magic:__ ~!Romanticist: Ameri can pull out her utmost power by trusting in her own strength, making it the Azazel Family's mightiest buff magic as it releases all of their power without limit. Because it is the greatest kind of self-hypnosis, it may be a double-edged sword that can even harm the user if they are afraid of the opponents they confront.!~

Ameri is the president of Babyls' Student Council. She is convinced humans exist, despite them only being myth in the demon world, and believes [Iruma](https://anilist.co/character/135018) to be one. Ameri hides the fact that she enjoys manga, "the forbidden books of the human world", and has Iruma read them to her in secret.

~!During the Student Council Training Arc is revealed that she is in love with Iruma!~

This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.

__Height:__ 153 cm
__Rank:__ ~!As of now in the Manga, Clara has achieved rank [4] *Daleth*.!~
__Familiars:__ ~!Falfal: a green-looking creature that is very eccentric, much like its owner.!~
__Inherited Magic:__ ~!Dimensional pockets: Clara can flawlessly duplicate or conjure any thing or object she has previously seen and pluck it out of one of her skirt pockets.!~

Clara is one of the stranger students at the school, acting very much like an excited child. She has abundant energy that most students can't keep up with. Other students find her weird and hard to deal with, but are drawn to her because her inherited power is so convenient. Since she had no friends, she would give students snacks and drinks as "payment" for playing with her. She is the second friend [Iruma](https://anilist.co/character/135018) made at Babyls.

Sullivan's servant who does the chores around the house.

Opera was Kalego's upperclassman when they were both students at Babyls.

Opera has a serious, down to earth personality. They often act as a voice of reason for Lord Sullivan, but are usually ignored. They are mostly reserved with their opinion, but will voice the occasional concern or cynical remark, and will sometimes dispense helpful advice.

Their interactions with Kalego reveal that they have a somewhat more mischievous and sadistic side not normally shown in their professional behavior, which was especially prominent when they were students at Babyls.

[Iruma Suzuki](https://anilist.co/character/135018/Suzuki-Iruma)'s Familiar/Contracted Demon

The homeroom teacher of the Misfit Class, and one of the prestigious professors at Babyls Demon School. Derisive, snappy, and short-tempered, he strongly dislikes demons who are boisterous, brash, and inconsiderate of others, believing them to be troublemakers. As such, he is generally pessimistic when dealing with his students. 

Due to how the familiar summoning spell works with humans, Kalego unwillingly becomes Iruma's familiar for a year. When summoned, Kalego appears as a fluffy white creature resembling a small crow, complete with black bat-like wings, black horns, and his distinctive front hair curl.

Sullivan is the adoptive grandfather of [Iruma](https://anilist.co/character/135018) and the principal of Babyls. He is one of the Three Heroes, the most powerful and influential demons in society, and is a possible candidate for the new Demon King. He's a Tet (9) Rank.

He is a classmate of [Iruma Suzuki](https://anilist.co/character/135018/Suzuki-Iruma) and the 13th student in the Misfit Class.

Although he was enrolled from the very beginning, his official introduction did not occur until the final event of the first-year curriculum. ~!This is because his bloodline ability is "Detection Warding," and the Purson family are a clan of covert operatives who have long held the principle of "never standing out" as their highest virtue.!~

~!While usually quiet and expressionless, he is actually an unstoppable chatterbox once he starts talking. He has a playful, spirited personality and—despite his deadpan look—possesses a fun mindset that allows him to handle both the "straight man" and "funny man" roles in comedy. He uses a perception-blocking ability to gather all sorts of dirt on his classmates, yet he remains a gentleman toward the girls. Like any guy his age, he wants to be popular with girls and dreams of having a cute girlfriend. He finds it baffling that his homeroom teacher is popular with the ladies (or so it seems). He harbors resentment toward male students and teachers who have girlfriends or are popular with girls—a sentiment that becomes particularly pronounced when he’s had a drink.

However, having lived a life trying to stay under the radar, he tends to monologue endlessly and struggles with the give-and-take of conversation (a fact he is well aware of). He was given a trumpet by his mother in childhood; whenever he felt an urge to talk but couldn't, he would play the instrument instead. Consequently, he is a highly skilled trumpeter capable of rapid-fire playing that mirrors his talkative nature. It is his daily routine to play on the school rooftop after classes end, a performance that has become a signal for the end of the school day. Because no one knows what he looks like, the students call him "Pixie."!~

Unexpectedly, he's extremely good-looking (ikemen) without his eyemask.

Eiko is a freshman student attending Babylus Demon School. She constantly tries to have a conversation with Iruma Suzuki ever since he saved her but fails every single effort throughout the series. She's somewhat sociable, as she's usually seen casually talking to multiple unnamed background characters, but mainly hanging with her close group of friends.

She is shy when talking to people she admires, such as when she attempts to thank Iruma for saving her, on multiple occasions. In this way, she appears polite and kind in nature.

Thanks to his family's bloodline magic, he can create illusions that replicate his victim's greatest fears, primarily a living being. The greater the trauma is, the higher the chance there are lingering effects of seeing another trauma happening. He uses his environment to visualize the illusion. Even with a tiny object, it is easy enough to conjure the trauma. The only way to counter and successfully end this suffering is for the target must have a strong will to overcome it.
